pages.seo_title: Shoulder Armor for Costumes & Stage | TheFEYA
pages.meta_description: Shop sculptural TheFEYA shoulder armor for costume, stage, cosplay and festival styling, with metallic, mirror and futuristic statement pieces.
pages.intro: Build the silhouette from the shoulders first. This TheFEYA selection brings together decorative shoulder pieces used across performance, festival and costume looks, from clean metallic shapes to futuristic and post-apocalyptic styling. Many designs use vegan leather with gold or silver finishes, while selected pieces incorporate mirror elements. These are fashion and costume pieces—not protective armor.

modules.heading: Choose the role of the shoulder piece
modules.body: Use the collection as a styling decision rather than a protective-equipment category. Some looks make the shoulders the main sculptural element; others combine them with arm pieces, a top, skirt, headpiece or full costume configuration. The exact options shown on each product page are the authoritative purchase choices.

modules.heading: From stage styling to futuristic costume
modules.body: The current membership is strongest in glam, futuristic, post-apocalyptic and cosmic directions, with performer and warrior personas appearing frequently in the approved Product DNA. Use those visual cues to narrow the look without creating a separate SEO page for every style or color.

faq.q: Is this protective shoulder armor?
faq.a: No. TheFEYA shoulder pieces are decorative costume and fashion pieces for visual styling. They are not sold as ballistic, tactical, motorcycle or other protective equipment.

faq.q: Can I buy one shoulder or a full shoulder set?
faq.a: Only when that option appears on the individual product page. Product configurations vary, so the selectable options and current server quote on the product page are the authority.
